# Family Football Project Notes

- React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, lucide-react, and Supabase JS.
- Keep GitHub Pages asset paths compatible with `base: './'`.
- Fixture data must be labeled as demo data and must not be presented as live NFL data.
- Keep Supabase service-role and NFL provider credentials out of browser code.
- Enforce membership, authorization, and kickoff deadlines in Postgres/RLS, not only in client UI.
